newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Montgomergy County, Md..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Montgomergy County, Md..

text.p: Consolidated Public Improvement Bonds of 1997, Series A

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Director of Finance of Montgomery County, Maryland (the Director of Finance''), in the offices of Smith, Somerville & Case, L.L.C., 100 Light Street, 5th Floor, Main Conference Room, Baltimore, Maryland, until 11:00 a.m. (EDT) on Tuesday,

for the purchase of the above-referenced issue of general obligation bonds, dated April 15, 1997, maturing (subject to prior redemption beginning May 1, 2007, as provided in the official Notice of Sale) on May 1 in the aggregate principal amount of $5,750,000 in each of the years 1998 to 2017, inclusive, and bearing interest payable on November 1, 1997 (six and one-half months), and semi-annually thereafter on May 1 and November 1 until maturity or earlier redemption. The proceeds of the sale of these bonds will be used for the purpose of providing permanent financing for the
construction and improvement of general public facilities, roads and bridges, storm water drainage systems, public schools, the community college, parks and recreation
facilities, mass transit facilities, and fire-fighting
facilities, including the acquisition of sites therefor, in Montgomery County, Maryland (the County'').
The bonds are general obligations of the County, and will constitute an irrevocable pledge of its full faith and credit and unlimited taxing power.

The bonds will be issued in fully registered, book-entry form through a system of registration maintained by The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, as securities depository and will be sold in beneficial interests of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the required form of proposal, and the official Notice of Sale for the bonds may be obtained from the Director of Finance, at the Executive Office Building, 101 Monroe Street, Rockville, Maryland 20850, or by telephone (301) 217-2042.
Reference should be made to the official Notice of Sale
